prompt: Maria wants to ensure that an NFS share from the server `nfs-server.example.com` is automatically mounted on her client machine at boot time. She decides to add an entry in a configuration file to achieve this. Which file should she edit to make sure the NFS share is mounted at boot?
explanation: `/etc/fstab` lists filesystems to be mounted at boot, so an NFS entry placed there is mounted automatically when the client starts.
